summary: Three runtime profiles and complete-workspace archives implemented. Automated checks pass in available macOS/D1-preview/SQLite/PostgreSQL environments; incomplete deployment verification remains explicitly unverified.

checks.title: Persist project data in durable workspace storage
checks.detail: r3: SQLite and real PostgreSQL commits survive restart; D1, SQLite and PostgreSQL preserve exact workspace JSON and durable retry outcomes. Transaction rollback and competing writes checked.

checks.title: Protect workspace and MCP access at the configured deployment boundary
checks.detail: r4: Standalone browser/API/MCP identity boundary, forged identity/forwarded headers, wrong Host/Origin, denied/revoked accounts and tokens checked. Existing Sites MCP byte limits and REST request limits retain regression coverage.

checks.title: Import workspaces and reconcile updates without bypassing review
checks.detail: r4: Archive restore/copy uses a distinct operation; conflicts cannot overwrite existing workspaces. Imported open proposals remain pending and existing reconciliation safeguards passed regression tests.

checks.title: Expose a remote MCP endpoint
checks.detail: r3: Official MCP SDK initialized, listed 18 tools and read projects with the browser closed against D1 preview, SQLite production server and PostgreSQL production server.

checks.title: Connect assistants to the selected deployment's MCP endpoint
checks.detail: r3: Integrations UI reports the actual profile, configured endpoint, authentication and 18-tool catalog. SDK 1.32.0 negotiated protocol 2025-11-25 in all three runtime profiles. Sites managed production MCP readback is recorded with release evidence.

checks.title: Support three deployment profiles from one application
checks.detail: r1: One source builds Sites and standalone output; clean standalone build/start needs no .openai configuration, Sites bindings, account or emulator. PostgreSQL production server and browser workflow ran independently of Cloudflare.

checks.title: Publish the current application reproducibly to ChatGPT Sites
checks.detail: r1: Sites production build and supported existing-Site source/build/package workflow used with the same Site ID, D1 and private audience. Final deployment identity/status is recorded separately in baseline implementation/evidence metadata.

checks.title: Start a durable local installation with embedded SQLite
checks.detail: r1: macOS arm64 clean npm ci, standalone build, setup, start, project/Draft creation and restart passed; SQLite locking, safe failures and MCP replay also passed. Required Linux clean-checkout execution remains unverified.

checks.title: Persist self-hosted workspaces in PostgreSQL
checks.detail: r1: PostgreSQL 17.10: independent pools and separate production app processes, same-key retries, competing stale writes, injected trigger rollback, restart and cross-backend transfer passed. External TLS certificate integration remains unexecuted.

checks.title: Configure deployments without rebuilding application source
checks.detail: r1: Runtime-only URL/port/database/auth configuration, explicit profile validation, unknown/unsafe combinations and forged proxy inputs checked. No source edits or Sites environment are needed by standalone builds.

checks.title: Initialize and upgrade each database safely
checks.detail: r1: Fresh and repeated SQLite/PostgreSQL migration, D1 migration chain, legacy storage preservation, schema mismatch/missing checks and SQLite lock recovery passed. Drizzle reports no schema drift. Production Sites migration result accompanies the deployment record.

checks.title: Package a production Docker image
checks.detail: r1: Committed multi-stage locked Dockerfile runs compiled output as non-root with no startup download, graceful shutdown and a tested Host-aware health probe. Docker image build/run and Linux CPU architecture execution were unavailable; no image digest is claimed.

checks.title: Provide Compose setups for bundled and external PostgreSQL
checks.detail: r1: Bundled persistent PostgreSQL and external PostgreSQL Compose files, migration dependencies, private secrets, readiness and loopback publication are implemented. No Docker daemon/Compose execution or external TLS database was available.

checks.title: Enforce an explicit access boundary outside Sites
checks.detail: r1: Password login, stable bearer actor, private account file validation, immediate token/account revocation, password rotation, durable session logout, anonymous/forged identity rejection and loopback restrictions passed.

checks.title: Back up and transfer complete deployment data
checks.detail: r1: D1↔SQLite, D1↔PostgreSQL and SQLite↔PostgreSQL representative complete archives round-trip exactly, including frozen content and actor-scoped retries. CLI all-project backup and empty SQLite restore passed; nonempty destinations are refused. Auth credentials/sessions remain excluded.

checks.title: Report health and preserve data through operational failures
checks.detail: r1: Standalone readiness/liveness, missing/newer schemas, invalid configuration, unusable path, contention, rollback/retry and restart recovery checked with safe errors. Docker/Compose operational recovery and an external PostgreSQL outage/recovery drill remain unexecuted.

checks.title: Document a verified quickstart for each deployment profile
checks.detail: r1: README and deployment guide document all profiles, runtime config, auth/MCP, upgrades, private backups, transfer, limits and reset. Exact clean macOS SQLite install/build/setup/start/restart commands passed. Linux and Docker/Compose quickstarts remain unverified.

checks.title: Verify deployment parity and upgrade safety
checks.detail: r1: Automated API/unit, separate-process, browser, SDK and cross-backend checks passed in the available environments. The full per-profile acceptance matrix is incomplete: Docker/Compose/Linux/external TLS and a separate-Worker live-update probe were not executed.

checks.title: Export complete project workspaces
checks.detail: r1: UI single-project export/import-copy passed on D1 preview, SQLite and PostgreSQL. All-project CLI backup/restore and multi-project archive tests passed; roots/history/receipts captured consistently without changing versions. UI progress/cancellation implemented and archive cancellation checked.

checks.title: Use an efficient versioned workspace archive
checks.detail: r1: Versioned ZIP uses SHA-256 logical records, deduplication and compression. Exact Unicode/unknown/absent fields, multiple projects, >2 MiB incompressible data, corruption, truncation, unsupported versions, unsafe paths, malformed references and expansion bounds checked.

checks.title: Preview and atomically import complete workspace archives
checks.detail: r1: Preview conflicts, selected restore/copy, no overwrite, atomic selected publication, injected import rollback, cancelled operation, same-operation retries and restart replay passed. Browser retries retain operation metadata across reload through sessionStorage.

checks.title: Preserve identity and provenance during workspace import
checks.detail: r1: Exact restore preserves historical values and retry actor scope; copy changes only live project identity. Immutable source assertions and inactive copied receipts are retained with separate import provenance, visibly labeled in the UI. Existing project data remains unchanged.

unit_and_api.skip_reason: Standalone production probes run separately against a standalone build.

executed.clean_checkout: npm ci; npm run build:standalone; WW_SQLITE_PATH=<private-test-db> npm run setup; WW_SQLITE_PATH=<same-db> WW_PORT=5185 npm start; project/Draft creation; stop/start; exact readback passed. No .openai directory or developer runtime configuration copied.
executed.cli_archive: npm run workspace -- backup <source-origin> <private-archive>; npm run workspace -- restore-empty <empty-destination-origin> <same-private-archive>; exact project/Draft readback passed.
executed.targeted_lint: no errors; existing anonymous default export style warning in Sites worker

commands: node --import tsx --test test/*.test.mjs (WW_TEST_POSTGRES_URL supplied through test environment)
node --import tsx --test test/standalone-process.test.mjs (clean standalone build; disposable PostgreSQL)
node --test test/portability.browser.mjs (separate SQLite and PostgreSQL production origins)
npm ci; npm run build:standalone; npm run setup; npm start
Sites supported site-workflow.mjs with build-site.mjs, source push and artifact packaging
limits: False checks identify incomplete verification; they do not mean an observed product test failure.
No Docker engine/Compose or Linux execution environment was available. No container/architecture test or image digest is claimed.
Real PostgreSQL ran locally with TLS disabled on loopback. External PostgreSQL TLS and outage drills remain unverified.
Not every historical UI workflow was repeated on every backend. Full live-update/unsaved-edit browser regressions ran on D1 preview.
Sites preview SDK testing uses emulator identity; managed production OAuth readback is separate baseline evidence.
Synthetic test data only. Private archives, database files, credentials and raw logs stay outside committed/public artifacts.
Implementation commit, actual Sites version/deployment and final verification evidence are associated with BL-015 through Wonderworks MCP.
